description:
## Objective

Make test/bench the only repository location for benchmark code, benchmark smoke tests, fixtures, runners, and documentation.

## Scope

Move and weave all current bench content into subsystem folders under test/bench. Preserve Signal, Action and Flow, and AI or ReAct workloads. Update Mix aliases, code loading paths, README links, the quality source manifest, the quality contract, and generated report metadata. Write generated output only under tmp/bench.

Do not change lib or refs.

## Acceptance criteria

- The repository has no tracked top-level bench folder.
- test/bench contains the smoke tests, manual runners, fixtures, support code, and benchmark documentation.
- No Mix alias, test, script, manifest record, or document refers to a top-level bench path.
- Quick benchmark smoke checks stay bounded and deterministic.
- Standard and stress profiles stay explicit and opt-in.
- mix test.bench exits with status 0.
- Every documented manual benchmark command loads from test/bench and exits with status 0 for its quick profile.
- mix quality.coverage and mix quality.report still collect benchmark evidence.

## Handoff

Record moved files, path changes, commands, results, and any deferred benchmark in the completion comment.

comments.text: Completed in a55e2b8 on main. Moved all Signal, Action/Flow, AI, and ReAct benchmark runners, support code, fixtures, smoke tests, and READMEs under test/bench. Removed the tracked top-level bench tree. Updated Mix aliases, CI commands, formatter inputs, README links, plan paths, source-manifest targets, test loader ignores, and cross-runner paths. Added layout and manifest-target guards. mix test.bench passed 22 tests. All four Action/Flow quick runners, Signal smoke, both AI two-request runners, and mix bench passed from the new paths. Focused layout/manifest/CI tests passed 11 tests. mix format --check-formatted and git diff --check passed. Generated reports stayed under tmp/bench. No lib or refs change. Deferred benchmarks: none. Remaining blocker: none.

title: Consolidate all benchmark assets under test bench
